title: Startup Advisory — Day 8: AoA, SHA Clauses and Statutory Registers
takeaway: A shareholders' agreement is largely unenforceable against the company unless mirrored in its Articles of Association, and missing statutory registers will halt investor due diligence cold.
action: Draft a 1-page educational checklist on "5 SHA Clauses to Mirror in Your AoA" and share it on LinkedIn as an informational update.
